behavior: Builds a Codex ReadyObservation with a turn and activity_revision 2, validates it, frames Request::MarkReviewed through write_frame/read_frame and asserts decode equality; then rejects five mutations: missing turn, empty turn, revision 0, binding generation 0 and Grok provider.

behavior: Every Request returned by request_fixtures (reserve, hello, status, five supervisor commands, six agent reports and ten cloud commands) and every Response in response_fixtures is bincode-framed and decoded equal, and each Debug rendering is asserted not to contain "165".
